name: Grand Mercure Hanoi
short_description: A 181-room hotel that opened in 2023 near the Temple of Literature, with a rattan-and-birdcage-lamp room design and a rooftop gym and pool.
ai_summary: Grand Mercure Hanoi opened in 2023 near the Temple of Literature, one of Hanoi's most significant cultural sites, offering straightforward room categories that make it approachable for a range of travelers. The 181-room hotel's design leans into warm brown tones with rattan headboards and bird-cage lamps, a noticeable step up from standard Mercure properties, and its breakfast buffet includes noodle and egg stations, fresh sushi, salads, and hot dishes. Guests consistently praise the stylish room design, helpful concierge service, and affordable pricing for the quality on offer, though lower floors have limited views due to neighbouring construction and the airport sits a notably long 45 minutes away.

faqs.question: When did Grand Mercure Hanoi open?
faqs.answer: In 2023, near the Temple of Literature -- one of Hanoi's most significant cultural sites -- with a design that's a noticeable step up from standard Mercure properties, featuring rattan headboards and bird-cage lamps.

faqs.question: Is Grand Mercure Hanoi far from the airport?
faqs.answer: Yes, relatively -- Noi Bai International Airport is about 30km away, roughly a 45-minute drive, which is longer than the airport transfer from many other Hanoi hotels closer to the centre.

reviews.title: Review: the Grand Mercure Hanoi hotel, an excellent new option
reviews.summary: Calls it a lovely new hotel with excellent value, praising the stylish rattan-and-birdcage-lamp room design, rooftop gym/pool, and Temple of Literature-area location, though lower floors have limited views and pool seating is limited.
